title: Harden CI/CD supply chain — add --ignore-scripts, pin npx versions, restrict workflow permissions
description:
## Source
SonarQube static analysis audit (`Data/Pages/audits/ms-sonar-static-analysis-7-26-26.md`)

## Findings
- **3 instances** missing `--ignore-scripts` in npm lifecycle scripts (`.github/workflows/ci.yml` L100, L167; `docs-pages.yml` L43)
- **2 instances** of `npx` without version pinning (`.github/workflows/ci.yml` L104, L171)
- **4 instances** of npm dependencies without version locking (`.github/workflows/ci.yml` L104, L171; `docs-pages.yml` L43, L46)
- **3 instances** of workflow-level permissions that should be job-level (`.github/workflows/docs-pages.yml` L11-L13)

## Impact
Supply-chain attack vectors — unverified package installations, unversioned tool execution, and over-broad workflow permissions violate least-privilege security principles.

## Action Required
1. Add `--ignore-scripts` to all `npm install`/`npm ci` invocations in both CI workflow files
2. Replace bare `npx` calls with explicitly versioned execution or pre-install tools
3. Add exact version pins to all npm package references
4. Move `permissions:` blocks from workflow root into individual jobs

## Effort
~8h

## Priority
P0 — Security
